description: Defines data structures related to PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) information, including configurations, UCI (Uplink Control Information), and scheduler UL allocation details within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_information
classes.description: Contains details about a PUSCH resource allocation, including configuration parameters, DMRS, HARQ, and transmission info.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_info
classes.description: Holds Uplink Control Information (UCI) details such as HARQ-ACK and CSI reporting configurations.

classes.name: ocudu::ul_sched_info
classes.description: Represents scheduler uplink allocation info, including PUSCH configuration and optional UCI, along with decision context.
